No where in the descrition dod i see the chemical sunscreens listed but this oil actually contains octorylene, octisalate and avobenzone and parfum. I will be returning
It protects the skin and it smells so good. Perfect tan without burning the skin. Very satisfied.
Gives you a dark, sophisticated tan and it holds for a long time! Love it!
So so hydrating - 10/10. Leaves your skin feeling amazing, with a lovely glow and a great tan. Would definitely recommend.
The one and only brand I use ,it give me a brownish tan not red or burnt.
I love the no spf version. But this one is just as good. Got super dark with the spf50 one on holiday. I even use it on my hair.
That smell - WOW! And feels great on the skin and has a long-lasting results.
No burning skin . This has to be the best sun screen I've ever used. I'm. Not a sun bather mostly under the umbrella. I've not had any peeling skin or prickly heat . My skin was so hydrated

LOVED this! The only thing I hate about this product is how small the bottle is other than that 10/10. I'm pretty light skin like light-medium in foundations and when I used this product I was pretty bronzed. It gives an amazing tan.
Never burn! I always develop a lovely colour and it is easy to apply!
Would love if it would have more SPF but it's a really nice tanning oil, love the smell, and it's not too oily
Easy to apply made my tan look amazing got a golden all over tan .will definitely buy again
Feeling light on your skin and hydrating. Smells gorgeous! Noticed a difference with how easily I was tanning.

I love this product so much I've been buying it on repeat 🙌🏻 It smells amazing (not really of watermelon, but a lovely sweet and slightly nutty scent). I wear it at the beginning and end of the day when the sun is less strong to deepen my tan . The results are outstanding. I'm usually fair but this gives me a lovely dark golden hue. Definitely recommend! 🍉 ♡
I've tried different oils from this series but this one is the best, it applies evenly, has an incredible scent and great long-lasting results.

The Watermelon Tanning Oil SPF15 by Bali Body is a summer must-have! It smells amazing—like fresh watermelon—and gives my skin the most beautiful golden glow. It's super hydrating, not sticky, and the added SPF15 gives light protection while still letting you tan. Perfect for beach days or lounging in the sun. I'm obsessed! ✨🌴
Perfect texture, smell. Dont leave spots on the bikini. Helps to have a bronzer natural brown skin. I like the bottle style too, very cool. Perfect choice for summer, my fav so far.

I've tried other tanning products from other brands and ended up in triggering serious rash all over the body. This product from Bali Body claims to be sensitive skin friendly which after multiple uses, I can say it worked really well with my tan and haven't caused any skin problems. Highly recommended for those with sensitive skin!
Been using Bali Body for 5+ years and it never disappoints. Provides the best natural glow with a nice smell and the best tan ever.

Got this for FREE with my tanning milk and omg it's the best ever I have such sensitive skin and don't usually tan well and I'm just back from 8 days in Croatia and I have the nicest tan ever and didn't get burnt so delighted will be repurchasing!!
Beautiful on the skin, smells amazing, not at all overpowering, Gave me a great deep long lasting tan
I love this product! It smells fantastic and really gives a nice tan without the sunburn.

First of all, super cute colour. Second of all shipping was SO fast I ordered it in the afternoon and it arrived the next morning. I used this tanning oil last year and LOVED IT smelt so good, this year I decided to buy the cocoa one for my holidays as I couldn't reccomend this brand more!
A must have - lovely smell, and gives gorgeous tan with nice protection

avis.titre: From a girl who would normally burn
avis.texte: This was the best product that I have ever tried for a holiday! I was sceptical as I always burn before I come close to a tan, however I used this and the spf 50 one together interchangeably and I didn't burn at all and had a nice tan! I was away for a week and the weather was mixed so I was shocked that I tanned at all! Smells great too!
Smells insane, definitely helped me tan. Be careful if high UV as I did burn a tiny bit more than I would with another SPF15 but I guess that just helps the tan excel.
This has given me the darkest tan I've ever had, easy to apply , smells great and leaves my skin soft , will definitely use again 👍

Love this oil and always use it when on a beach holiday! If I'm super pale I start using it on day 2 or 3 and even though the SPF level is low, never had any burns with this oil. Beautiful tanned skin and smells amazing!! The only downside of the sweet smell is it may attract flies or bees 😅 happened a couple of times!

So the bottle is the size of a credit card. Ive never seen anything like this, its so hilarious. Why would they make any body product this tiny? Im laughing in disbelief at this bottle. If i used the entire bottle it would maybe cover one of my legs. And im thin.
Lush smell & Fabulous Oil smooth& not too gready soaks in perfectly ..I use it as a Body lotion because its so easy
Smells great, rubs in nicely, and tans well with just enough UV protection!
super product. Feld very light on the skin. very recommandable.

avis.titre: First time used this tanning oil
avis.texte: Would highly recommend this for fair to medium skin colour, really helped to build a colour

I took this oil with me to France a few weeks ago and I have purchased it as far back as 3 years ago when I went home to South Africa! Both times I was absolutely inlove. This oil is the best feeling oil I've ever used on my skin ( light weight ) and its smell is so fresh and lovely; it's also not overpowering at all. The oil is great if you have dry skin too, keeps me moisturised all day and even the next day after use 💞

i love the scent of this oil & it is super hydrating. my skin love this but i wish this company would continue making more tanning oil. i hate that they are slowing discontinuing a lot of great stuff that is what made their company in the first place. please keep producing tanning oils !!!

This product works the way it's intended. Excels your tan, I put this only on my legs when sun bathing and I could feel the product warming up and working. Smell is great. Water resistant didnt come off easily. Only downside is its a little pricey for the amount you get, I took a photo of the bottle for reference and I have little baby hands.

avis.titre: I need to read the description better
avis.texte: Im so annoyed about this purchase, for some reason, no matter how many times I came back, I thought this was more then a tannig oil, I thought it also left a bronze glow. That being said, the bottle is way to small, it also says to use another spf with the product to protect your skin. Its a lovely product but for the amount you receive ans having to use another product with it, its not worth the purchase. Save your money
This product does work abaoultoey wonderul im a very pale person and rbis prsoxut has gave me rhe best tan with no burn but the bottle is really small ive only used it three times and its almost out

I bought this on a whim to try as i was desperate for any sun tanning solution and let me say this has been an unexpected winner! I used it while at a water park hoping to get my backside even and my legs to match my arms. This product has worked better then I could've ever imagined. It smells amazing, a little goes a long way, and it gets you a very nice even tan all throughout your body wherever you use it. I did go ahead and layer the product first having it as my base then a layer of sunblock and then I topped it off with another layer on top. If there was only one thing I could complain about, it would be the amount that you get for the price. While a little does go along way. I just don't know if the price offsets everything else.
The bottle is freaking tiny for 23 dollars. i shouldve looked at the ounces but the bottle just looked bigger in the picture. im not sure how good it is ive only used it once but it smells good

I don't waste my time writing reviews. But girl I need to tell you what just happened. So I am so pale, I know so sad. Okay, so I didn't want a tanning oil to give me a false tan, and ma'am when I tell YOU that I'm proud of this tan because I earned it. The oil smells so nice. I paired it with an spf 50, and I'm new to tanning and you best believe I burn easy. So when I tell you I TANNED. I feel so much better about the way I look. When I say it's only been 15 MINUTES, Jaw on the floor. Picking it up now because it is still devolving and I'm STILL getting darker. Like girl…my pasty self is getting darker? Yes…take my money agin because I'm getting another. I'm bummed I'm only getting like 7-10 uses out of it. But if it works it works. And I am working with this sun right now. Watch me be a bronze goodness by the SUMMER girl. 10/10 oil, you won't find anything better. I promise you that

I never write reviews, but i have to tell you guys everything about this. So i never bought oil before right, so i didnt know where to start. I was so afraid to burn or get a fake tan too like the other products. Oh my gosh guys, this oil works so well. It smells so good too. It doesnt give you a false tint or anything before hand and it will activally make you proud of your tan. I always hated fake reviews from insta or tiktok, but i found this one by myself and im so surprised it woked so well. Im super pale, and i never go out. The way it tanned me in one session..flabbergasted…immediately. I feel so confident. I pairded it with a spf 50, and the oil. The oil gave me such an even and bronze tan. Its still forming curently. But this is within 15 MINUTES. Im so dispapointed the bottle is so small for the price. It will give me 7-10 sessions. But honestly its be worth it.
Worth the money. Not greasy or oily, very moisturizing and smells great. Best tanning oil I've ever used!
Love it! I'm caucasian with olive skin . Never tanned so quickly, safely, and so dark. Excellent job creating it.

When I tell you I have never tanned naturally in my life, I promise you that. I was committed to having tanned skin that I have literally been applying fake tan since I was 16 every 3 nights lol!! It's very annoying, and I've always been super insecure about it. Happy to report!!! This 100% works! Having very fair skin, I used it and only layed in the sun for about 10-15 minutes for the first week. And already I had colour to me not that awful white almost purple looking skin. Keeping in my mind my normal process is burn, peel, gain some freckles and stay white lol. So this was HUGE. I also showered and mousturised straight after, not sure if this helps but I feel like it did! The before and after picture is not a lie and I'm so happy about it! A week and a half!!! For about 10-15 minutes each side for about 5 days!!! What the heck!! I'm just so happy I found this, now I feel like I can actually enjoy myself this summer instead of not going in water and doing fun things because of a fake tan lol! If you're unsure, I promise you!! I am so happy with my decision right now 🙏🏼🥰🫶🏼🫶🏼
This tanning oil is so light and refreshing, the scent is amazing and it is not too thick like other tanning oils, it feels smooth on the skin and so refreshing.
The best on the market. Works so well and smells so yummy! Results are amazing.

My new go-to for summer! I was encouraged by the reviews praising this product and Bali Body did not disappoint! It has a pleasant smell with just a hint of watermelon, it doesn't stain and most importantly it gives you an ultimate, glowing and extra dark tan. I did not burn at all 🥵 I'm in love with this tanning oil and I will be restocking for my next holidays.

I tried so many tanning oils but this one ist by far the best. I smells so good and creates the deepest tan that is available for your skin tone. The application is good and one bottle is perfect for one vacation. I love this product!!
Used this in Mexico! Great tan. A little goes a long way so don't be too concerned by little bottle!

This is the best tanning oil!Jjust used up my second bottle and will definitely be buying another one. Application is great, its not sticky and haven't noticed it leaving clothing with oil marks. Haven't found a tanning oil that gets me a dark tan like this one does.
Amazing tanning oil, the only "down side" (if one can even call it that), is that smells more like a bubble gum than watermelon. But would still definitely purchase it again :)
Love this product, gave me a lovely deep tan after first use!
Amazing product. Its my 3rd bottle. Absolutely love it! My tan looks fabulous.

avis.titre: If you like oil you'll love this!
avis.texte: I love the way this oil smells and it works as a nice sunscreen. I've purchased 4 bottles since last year.
I think it's going to be a great tan on my light skin as I get tan but it's hard in winter

That being said i didn't get a burn either which i usually do burn quite easily with SPF15.
Amazing smell and does the job. I gave to try it out for my girls while on holiday at Turkey and they loved it too, they even went to buy this themselves 😄
Love this for holidays hydration with some protection while we wander the streets of Greece this July!
I am obsessed with Balibody but especially this tanning solution! I love that there is a bigger size now! Long lasting, easy to use, & always looks flawless!

I am a repeat customer and this is my go to self tanner. I have bought self tanners from drug stores and they never came out looking natural. This gives you a bronze look and absolutely NO ORANGE COLOR!! I was asked by my coworkers if I went on vacation over the weekend lol That's how natural of a tan this is!!

I did everything as it was described, exfoliated first, rubbed my body with body lotion (especially on the dry spots) and the day after I used the self-tanner. Left it on for 1 hour and the result was pretty good at first! The result a few days (almost a week now) later is SICK --> see picture! My whole body is full of spots. I look ridiculous. Since I did not want to have situations like this I also bought the "Self Tan Remover", I have used it 7 times now and even let it soak in. NOTHING works, it only gets worse! The product is really not quality. No quality while you pay a lot.

avis.titre: Best oil and smells so good :-)
avis.texte: Awesome Results! My two daughters ages 18 and 15 love this product !
P.S. Attached photo is how greasy it is, the sunscreen has sit on my hand for more than 20 min already, doesn't sink in

I had great expectations of this product from what I'd seen on IG and other reviews. However that's not the case. Unless you have flawless skin to begin with this product doesn't blend great. I used it with the BB cream as suggested and found myself looking more like Donald trump. Followed all the instructions, tried blenders, brushes.. but for me it's a big fail.
I wouldn't recommend to buy if you have a good exfoliater tbh.

Leaves your skin so soft Wonderful product. Only one drawback. You cannot hardly get it out of the bottle. It wont come out unless you take the top off and squeeze and shake bottle. Product is too thick which is great but this product would be better packaged in a jar.
Love this tanned look! The serum is so easy to use, smells awesome and gives me a shine/ glow that I really love

I love this product. I use it after my usual night routine most nights and it looks so good each morning. I hate wearing make up and I don't need to wear it anymore, my skin looks tanned and glowy! So glad I purchased this product!
i love the bali body ultra dark self tanning mousse! the only thing i do not like about it is that it leaves you all sticky after application. 100% would recommend

wasnt bad enjoyed the smell and consistency but i've had better comparing to what they show i was slyly expecting some crazy colour change. I used the WHOLE bottle in 5 days laying in the sun straight for 4-6 hours.. i didnt burn but i didnt go DARK like they show on photos

The body highlighter and face serum are okay for me, they have no smell at all which I love, and they do give you a nice glow on your skin. Not sticky not oily at all. The brush is reaaaally good. I ordered this Bundle because of the Instant Tan and even though I finally liked how it looks on my skin, it keeps on transferring to everything I wear. Not sure if I'm doing something wrong during application.
Unless you leave it on overnight, you will only get a natural glow! It works great and if used correctly looks natural.

Lesson learned to always read return policies before purchasing with new companies. If you want to try these products, I'd try them from Ulta first where you know you can return it if there are issues or you don't like the product. Bali has a no return policy.
